spec.outfit: an 18th-century English gentleman's suit of the 1770s -- a black felt tricorne hat (three-cornered, brim turned up on three sides) with a thin black braid edge; a long deep navy-blue wool frock coat reaching the knees, worn open, with a narrow standing collar, a row of round gilt buttons down each front edge, gold braid along the front edges, large turned-back gold-braided cuffs at the forearms, and full coat skirts at the back that hang loose behind the legs; an ivory silk waistcoat to the hips embroidered with small gold flowers, buttoned with small gilt buttons; a white linen cravat tied at the throat with a short lace jabot falling over the waistcoat; white lace ruffles at the wrists; navy-blue knee breeches fastened below the knee with a small gilt buckle; white silk stockings; black leather shoes with a low heel and a large square silver buckle
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real fabric textures, clean period tailoring, every garment complete and well fitted to the goose's body. Elegant but not a costume-party exaggeration: no wig, no sword, no cane. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged. The goose has NO tail.
